# InGenius Prep

> > InGenius Prep provides comprehensive college admissions, law school, and medical school application guidance through strategic planning and expert advice.

InGenius Prep offers detailed resources for students navigating undergraduate admissions, pre-med requirements, law school applications (including LSAT and diversity statements), and medical school applications through AMCAS. The platform provides year-by-year planning guides, essay writing strategies, and practical advice on course selection, testing, and application processes.

## Key Topics

- College Admissions Strategy
- AMCAS Application System
- MCAT Preparation
- Law School Applications
- LSAT
- Pre-Med Requirements
- Personal Statement Writing
- Supplemental Essays
- High School Planning
- Application Strategy
- Diversity Statements
- Socioeconomic Context
- Course Selection
- SAT Testing
- Extracurricular Activities

## Medical School Admissions

- [A Step-by-Step Guide to the AMCAS Application System 2025](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/amcas-application-system): Complete walkthrough of AMCAS medical school application system for 2025
- [Pre-Med Requirements for Every Year of College: How to Best Prepare](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/pre-med-requirements-for-every-year-of-college): Year-by-year pre-med timeline covering courses, MCAT, and clinical experience

## Law School Admissions

- [A Comprehensive Guide to the Law School Diversity Statement](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/law-school-diversity-statement): How to write effective law school diversity statements for JD applications
- [So You Finished the LSAT - Now What?](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/so-you-finished-the-lsat): Post-LSAT next steps for law school application process completion

## College Application Essays & Writing

- [7 Editing Techniques to Help Improve the Personal Statement](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/7-editing-techniques-to-help-improve-the-personal-statement): Seven revision techniques for strengthening college personal statements
- [How to Write the Duke Supplemental Essays](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/how-to-write-the-duke-supplemental-essays): Essay writing guide for Duke University supplemental application prompts

## High School Planning & Course Selection

- [High School Courses: How to Strategically Select Your Classes](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/high-school-courses-how-to-strategically-select-your-classes): Strategic course selection guide balancing rigor and academic performance
- [Avoiding the Sophomore Slump: How to Take Advantage of Your 2nd Year of High School](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/sophomore-slump): 10th grade planning tips for academics, extracurriculars, and college prep
- [Foreign Language Requirements: Do They Matter for College Applications?](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/foreign-language-requirements): Analysis of foreign language requirements for college admissions success

## College Selection & Application Strategy

- [The Top 115 Colleges with No Application Fee in 2025](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/colleges-with-no-application-fee): List of 115 colleges offering no-fee or waived application fees in 2025
- [Public vs Private College: How to Find the Right Fit](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/public-vs-private-college-how-to-find-the-right-fit): Comparison guide: public vs private colleges covering cost, size, and fit
- [Privilege in College Admissions: Framing Your Background on Applications](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/privilege-in-college-admissions): Guide on framing socioeconomic background post-admissions scandal era

## Optional

- [5 Books You Should Read if You Want to Be a History Major](https://ingeniusprep.com/blog/5-books-for-history-majors): Five essential reading recommendations for aspiring history majors
